name: Larry Householder

summary.text: Larry Householder was Speaker of the Ohio House of Representatives. In March 2023 a federal jury convicted him of leading a racketeering conspiracy in which FirstEnergy paid nearly $61 million through the nonprofit Generation Now to secure his speakership and pass House Bill 6, a nuclear-plant bailout. He was sentenced to 20 years, the statutory maximum. The Sixth Circuit affirmed in May 2025, denied rehearing in July 2025, and the Supreme Court denied review on April 27, 2026.

facts.claim: The Sixth Circuit affirmed both convictions in a published May 2025 opinion, finding no reversible error; it called the explanation for the sentencing loss enhancement cursory but held the error harmless.
